scripts.text:
[Airship Crew]
If we've landed at
your destination and
you'd like to leave the
Airship, please use the
stairs up ahead. Thank
you for your patronage.
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇船员]
如果您已抵达目的地并想离开飞空艇，请使用前方的楼梯。感谢您的搭乘。

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Wow, mom!
L-look at this!
We're flying! W-we're...
We're in the freakin' sky!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
哇，妈妈！
看、看这个！
我们在飞！我、我们……
我们在该死的天上！

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Makumalagu!
Saampa joojimbo
kaku na jedi Solo.
Bwahahahahahahaah!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
Makumalagu！
Saampa joojimbo
kaku na jedi Solo。
Bwahahahahahahaah！

scripts.text:
[Lady]
Shush...
Honey, behave~
Don't act so excited
when we're out in a
public place like this!
scripts.translation:
[女士]
嘘……
亲爱的，乖一点~
在这种公共场合，
别表现得这么兴奋！

scripts.text:
[Lady]
Chooktu!
Sacraup matii!
Shaka gurftalfi
huntiki manjoo!
scripts.translation:
[女士]
Chooktu！
Sacraup matii！
Shaka gurftalfi
huntiki manjoo！

scripts.text:
[Chrmlim]
Hey there~
From that look on
your face, I see that
you can understand
me. ^333333*Whew...!*^000000
scripts.translation:
[查姆林]
你好呀~
从你的表情来看，
我发现你能听懂
我的话。^333333*呼……！*^000000

scripts.text:
[Chrmlim]
I've been helping the
Airship enterprise by
having the Airship Crewmen
train in Umbala to overcome
any acrophobia they might have through bungee jumping. Neat, eh?
scripts.translation:
[查姆林]
我一直通过让飞空艇船员在汶巴拉进行蹦极训练来克服恐高症，以此帮助飞空艇企业。很酷吧？

scripts.text:
[Chrmlim]
But...
Some of them couldn't
overcome their fear of
heights. And a few even
ended up, um, ^333333in Niflheim^000000.
scripts.translation:
[查姆林]
但是……
有些人无法克服
对高度的恐惧。甚至有几个人最终，嗯，^333333去了尼福尔海姆^000000。

scripts.text:
[Chrmlim]
Bajoo ga
nukta Airship.
scripts.translation:
[查姆林]
Bajoo ga
nukta Airship。

scripts.text:
[Chrmlim]
Shabala moow bajama
Airship kulaha googoona 
salu. Dama, kookoo na nu
yukuta. Um, fashuku na ret!
scripts.translation:
[查姆林]
Shabala moow bajama
Airship kulaha googoona
salu。Dama，kookoo na nu
yukuta。Um，fashuku na ret！

scripts.text:
[Airship Staff]
Welcome
to the Airship.
How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工作人员]
欢迎
来到飞空艇。
有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text: Do you have a passenger named Thierry?
scripts.translation: 有一位名叫蒂埃里的乘客吗？

scripts.text:
[Airship Staff]
I am sorry, but I do not think that we have a passenger by that name.
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工作人员]
抱歉，我想我们没有叫这个名字的乘客。

scripts.text:
[Airship Staff]
Welcome
to the Airship.
How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工作人员]
欢迎
来到飞空艇。
有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text: Using the Airship
scripts.translation: 使用飞空艇

scripts.text: Captain's Cabin
scripts.translation: 船长室

scripts.text: Facilities
scripts.translation: 设施

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Airship Staff]
When you see a broadcast
announcing that we have
arrived at your destination,
please use one of the exits
located at the north and
south ends of the Airship.
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工作人员]
当您看到广播宣布我们已抵达您的目的地时，请使用位于飞空艇南北两端的出口之一。

scripts.text:
[Airship Staff]
If you happen to miss
your stop, don't worry.
The Airship is constantly
en route and you'll get
another chance to arrive
to your intended destination.
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工作人员]
如果您不小心错过了站点，请不用担心。飞空艇一直在运行，您将有机会再次抵达预定目的地。

scripts.text:
[Airship Staff]
The Captain's Cabin
is located at the front
of the Airship. There, you
can meet the captain and
the pilot of the Airship.
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工作人员]
船长室位于飞空艇的前部。在那里，您可以见到飞空艇的船长和飞行员。

scripts.text:
[Airship Staff]
The Airship provides
various Mini Games for
the entertainment of all
our passengers. We invite
you to try your luck and skills
in the Airship's Mini Games~
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工作人员]
飞空艇为所有乘客提供各种迷你游戏以作娱乐。我们邀请您在飞空艇的迷你游戏中试试运气和技巧~

scripts.text:
[Airship Staff]
Well, I hope you
your flight aboard
our Airships. Thank
you and have a good day.
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工作人员]
嗯，希望您享受
乘坐我们飞空艇的
旅程。谢谢，祝您
愉快。

scripts.text:
[Zerta]
Oh, hello adventurer.
I am currently on a
sacred journey, offering
prayer for the sake of the
Midgard continent.
scripts.translation:
[泽塔]
哦，你好，冒险者。
我正在进行一场神圣的
旅程，为米德加尔特大陆
祈祷。

scripts.text:
[Maelin]
Um, this Airship is
to Lutie, isn't it? I've
waiting so long,
but I haven't heard any
broadcast about Lutie.
scripts.translation:
[梅琳]
嗯，这艘飞空艇是
去姜饼城的，对吧？我
等了很久，但一直没听到
关于姜饼城的广播。

scripts.text:
[Aanos]
Oh wooow~
The sky looks
so different and
pretty from up there!
scripts.translation:
[阿诺斯]
哦哇~
从天上看，
天空看起来如此不同
且美丽！

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
I wish that I could go drink a cold fresh beer.
Drinking is the goal of my life! Drinking gives me energy!
I am nothing without drinks!
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
我真想去喝杯冰镇新鲜啤酒。
喝酒是我人生的目标！喝酒给我能量！
没有酒我就什么都不是！

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
But! Driving under the influence is not good.
But! That makes me want to drink more and more!
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
但是！酒后驾驶不好。
但是！这让我更想喝了！

scripts.text: Do you know a passenger named Thierry?
scripts.translation: 你认识一位名叫蒂埃里的乘客吗？

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
This uniform is
really dapper, but
it's way too thick to
wear around the Airship.
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
这身制服确实
很帅气，但在飞空艇
周围穿实在太厚了。

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
...
......
No one ever really
comes into this room.
And the captain IS a reindeer. I could just strip to my boxers.
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
……
………
真的没人会进
这个房间。
而且船长是只驯鹿。我干脆只穿内裤算了。

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
Wah!? Who is it!
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
哇！？是谁！

scripts.text: - ...He is not listening to you, at all. -
scripts.translation: - ……他根本没在听你说话。 -

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
It's been sooo
long since I've
enjoyed a nice, cold
alcoholic brew. But the
job requires me to be as
clear headed as I can!
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
我已经好久没
好好享受一杯冰镇
酒精饮料了。但工作
要求我必须保持头脑
清醒！

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
Always drink responsibly!
Still, I can't remember the
last time I had a real vacation
or even a day off. Yeap, some
booze, some chips, some TV
and serious R&R is in order.
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
饮酒要适度！
不过，我都记不清上次
真正休假或休息一天是
什么时候了。是的，来点
酒，来点薯片，看看电视，
好好休息一下才是正经事。

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
Man, the weather
is really nice today.
Bright, open skies make
for some good visibility
and safe, carefree flying.
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
伙计，今天的天气
真好。
晴朗开阔的天空带来
良好的能见度，飞行
安全又无忧。

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
You know, our captain's a
respectable guy. Him and
his brother are actually well
known in the aircraft industry.
Who knew reindeer made
such good captains?
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
你知道吗，我们的船长是个
值得尊敬的人。他和
他的兄弟在航空业其实
很有名。谁能想到驯鹿能
成为这么优秀的船长？

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
Just between you
and me, I gotta tell
you, that Santa was onto
something, getting reindeers
and elves to work for him.
The man must be a genius!
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
私下跟你说，我得告诉
你，那个圣诞老人让驯鹿
和精灵为他工作真是有眼光。
那人一定是个天才！

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
You know, this whole
piloting thing in the air,
it's rather new, you know?
Yeah, they got this Airship
operation in a hurry.
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
你知道，这种空中
驾驶的事情还挺新的，
对吧？是啊，他们匆忙
建立了这个飞空艇运营项目。

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
Still, they were real
serious, really thought
ahead. I mean, they had us
training while the Airships
were still being invented.
Isn't that freakin' crazy?!
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
不过，他们非常认真，
很有远见。我是说，他们在
飞空艇还在发明阶段时就让我们
开始训练了。这不疯狂吗？！

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
Welcome to Fruitz's
Shop where you can
purchase Apples or grind
them to make Apple Juice.
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
欢迎来到弗鲁茨商店，
在这里您可以购买苹果或
将其研磨制成苹果汁。

scripts.text: Buy Apples.
scripts.translation: 购买苹果

scripts.text: Make Apple Juice.
scripts.translation: 制作苹果汁

scripts.text: Why are you here?
scripts.translation: 你为什么在这里？

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
Please enter the amount
of Apples that you wish to
buy. Each Apple is 15 zeny
and you can buy a maximum
of 500 at a time. Please enter
 '0' to cancel your order.
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
请输入您希望购买的
苹果数量。每个苹果15泽尼，
每次最多可购买500个。请输入
'0'取消订单。

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
Thanks for stopping
by my shop. Farewell!
Come by anytime when
you feel like having an
Apple to snack on~
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
感谢光临本店。再见！
想吃苹果当零食时，
随时欢迎再来~

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
You've entered a number
higher than the maximum
value of 500. Please enter
the number of Apples you
wish to purchase again.
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
您输入的数字超过了
最大值500。请重新输入
您希望购买的苹果数量。

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
A total of ^FF0000{0}^000000 Apples
will cost you ^FF0000{1}^000000 zeny.
Would you like to continue?
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
总共^FF0000{0}^000000个苹果
将花费您^FF0000{1}^000000泽尼。
您要继续吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
Thanks for stopping
by my shop. Farewell!
Come by anytime when
you feel like having an
Apple to snack on~
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
感谢光临本店。再见！
想吃苹果当零食时，
随时欢迎再来~

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
I'm sorry, but you don't
have enough money to
purchase that many Apples.
Please check your zeny or
purchase fewer Apples.
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
抱歉，您的钱不够
购买这么多苹果。
请检查您的泽尼或
减少购买数量。

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
Hmmm, I don't think
you've got enough room in
your inventory to carry this
many Apples. Why don't you free up some of your inventory space?
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
嗯，我觉得您的物品栏
空间不足以携带这么多
苹果。何不腾出一些物品栏空间呢？

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
Thanks for stopping by
my shop. I hope you enjoy
the flavor of these Apples~!
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
感谢光临本店。希望您
喜欢这些苹果的味道~！

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
Okay, I'll need
^FF00003 Apples and 1 Empty Bottle^000000
to make 1 Apple Juice for you.
Would you like to proceed?
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
好的，我需要
^FF00003个苹果和1个空瓶^000000
为您制作1瓶苹果汁。
您要继续吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
I'm sorry, but you don't
have enough materials to
create a bottle of Apple Juice.
Remember, I need 3 Apples
and 1 Empty Bottle to do it.
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
抱歉，您的材料不足
以制作一瓶苹果汁。
记住，我需要3个苹果
和1个空瓶才能制作。

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
Thank you,
please wait
just a moment.
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
谢谢，
请稍等
片刻。

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Grind grind*
*Grind grind*
*Clang...!*^000000

[Fruitz]
There you go~
I hope you enjoy!
Please feel free to
stop by for your Apple
and Apple Juice needs
at anytime, adventurer~
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
给您~
希望您喜欢！
如有苹果或苹果汁的需求，
冒险者，请随时光临~

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
Thanks for stopping
by my shop. Farewell!
Come by anytime when
you feel like having an
Apple to snack on~
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
感谢光临本店。再见！
想吃苹果当零食时，
随时欢迎再来~

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
I used to be a wandering
vagabond when, one day,
I took a nap and something
struck my head and awoke
me from my restful slumber.
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
我曾经是个流浪汉，有一天，
我打了个盹，有什么东西
击中了我的头，把我从
安睡中唤醒。

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
It turns out that I was
sleeping beneath an apple
tree and that an apple fell
and hit me on the head.
I was dying of hunger and
was about to eat that Apple...
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
原来我睡在一棵苹果树下，
一个苹果掉下来砸中了我的头。
我当时饿得要死，正准备吃掉那个苹果……

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
But suddenly, Kain, my old
friend from the mining days,
asked me to help him around
on the Airship. So I did, and
it was there where I found some
people playing the Dice game.
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
但突然，我在采矿时期的老朋友凯恩
请求我在飞空艇上帮他忙。于是我去了，
就在那里，我发现了一些人在玩骰子游戏。

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
I was bored and curious
and ended up wagering that
single Apple in a game of
dice. But for some reason,
I had this incredible lucky
streak. One apple became two...
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
我又无聊又好奇，结果把那
唯一的苹果押在了骰子游戏中。
但不知为何，我的运气好得惊人。
一个苹果变成了两个……

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
Two became four and
before I knew it, I had
cornered the Apple market!
I won so many Apples, I just
started my own business here
on the Airship. Weird, huh?
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
两个变成四个，
不知不觉间，我垄断了
苹果市场！我赢了那么多苹果，
干脆在飞空艇上开了自己的店。
很奇怪吧？

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
So Apples are good
for you. They were
certainly very good
to me. Hahahahaah~!
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
所以苹果对你有好处。
它们对我确实很好。哈哈哈~！

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
Thank you for
using my shop.
Farewell~
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
感谢使用
我的商店。
再见~

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
Longitude, 131 degrees east.
Latitude, 37 degrees north.
We're right on course, captain.
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
东经131度。
北纬37度。
航线正确，船长。

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
Looks like a really
cloudy day. Always hard
to navigate when the skies
aren't clear. Guess we'll
need to amp the radar.
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
看起来今天云层很厚。
天空不明朗时总是很难导航。
看来我们需要增强雷达信号。

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
The Captain is a good
man and I can't think of
a finer person to command
this ship. Still, he's pretty
tough, a real slave driver.
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
船长是个好人，我想不出
有谁能比他更适合指挥这艘船。
不过，他相当严厉，是个真正的监工。

scripts.text:
[^ff0000Tarlock^000000]
^ff0000Hey...!^000000
^ff0000Less chit-chat^000000
^ff0000and more piloting!^000000

[Pilot]
R-right away, sir!
(See what I mean?)
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
马、马上就去，先生！
（明白我的意思了吧？）

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
This uniform is
really dapper, but
it's way too thick to
wear around the Airship.
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
这身制服确实
很帅气，但在飞空艇
周围穿实在太厚了。

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
...
......
No one ever really
comes into this room.
And the captain IS a reindeer.
I could just strip to my boxers.
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
……
………
真的没人会进
这个房间。
而且船长是只驯鹿。
我干脆只穿内裤算了。

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
Oh...! Hello there!
E-e-enjoying your flight?!
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
哦……！你好！
享、享受您的飞行吗？！

scripts.text:
[Dianne]
It's so weird!
I went to visit the
Airship Captain and
all I saw was this
weird reindeer. Oh!
Do you think that...
scripts.translation:
[黛安]
真奇怪！
我去拜访飞空艇船长，
结果只看到一只奇怪的
驯鹿。哦！你觉得那是……

scripts.text:
[Mendel]
As I expected, the
in-flight meals are
three star quality at best.
*Harrrumph* I really should
have brought my chef so that
I could enjoy a real meal.
scripts.translation:
[门德尔]
如我所料，机上餐点
最多也就是三星水准。
*哼* 我真该带上我的厨师，
这样就能享用真正的美食了。

scripts.text:
[Swordsman Shimizu]
Finally, after five
years of waiting...
I can have my revenge!
scripts.translation:
[剑士 清水]
终于，经过五年的等待……
我可以复仇了！

scripts.text:
[Swordsman Shimizu]
I just...
Have to make sure that
I don't keep missing my
stop. But soon, very soon,
vengeance will be mine!
scripts.translation:
[剑士 清水]
我只需……
确保不再错过站点。
但很快，非常很快，
复仇就是我的了！

scripts.text:
[Clarice]
Hi, I'm Clarice~
How would you like
to wager some Apples
in a friendly game of Dice?

[克拉丽丝]
嗨，我是克拉丽丝~
您想在友好的骰子游戏中
押注一些苹果吗？

scripts.text: Play Dice Game
scripts.translation: 玩骰子游戏

scripts.text: Learn Dice Game Rules
scripts.translation: 了解骰子游戏规则

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm up for a game of
dice whenever you feel
like it. Just talk to me if
you ever get hit with the
sudden urge to gamble, kay?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我随时准备和您玩骰子。
如果您突然想赌博，
随时找我聊聊，好吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The rules for the Dice game
are pretty simple. First, you
place a bet by wagering Apples.
You can bet a maximum of 50
Apples at a time. To keep things
legal, I can only accept Apples.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
骰子游戏的规则很简单。
首先，您通过押注苹果下注。
每次最多可押注50个苹果。
为了合法，我只能接受苹果。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But hey, if all that zeny
is burning a hole in your
pocket, head over to Fruitz
and you can buy as many
Apples as you want, playah~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不过嘿，如果那些泽尼
在您口袋里烫手，
去找弗鲁茨，您可以想买多少
苹果就买多少，玩家~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Now, we begin with me
rolling two 6-sided dice.
When it's your turn, you'll
roll two 6-sided dice. After
that, both of us will have the
option of rolling a third die.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
现在，我开始掷两个六面骰子。
轮到您时，您也将掷两个六面骰子。
之后，我们双方都可以选择掷第三个骰子。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Now here's the important
thing. If your total is higher
than 12, you'll bust, meaning
that you lose. Otherwise, the
person with the higher total
is the winner. Got it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
现在重要的是。
如果您的总数超过12，您就爆掉，
意味着您输了。否则，
总数较高的人获胜。明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Now, you'll be the first
to decide whether or not
you'll roll the third die. Then,
depending on your result, I'll
roll my third die... Or maybe not.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
现在，您将首先决定是否
掷第三个骰子。然后，
根据您的结果，我将掷我的第三个骰子……
或者不掷。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
When you win, you'll
receive twice as many
Apples as you wagered.
But if we happen to tie, you
get the Apples that you bet
returned to you. Fair, right?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
当您获胜时，您将获得
两倍于您押注的苹果。
但如果我们平局，您拿回
您押注的苹果。公平吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ooh, so you'll play with
me? Great! How many
Apples would you like to bet?
Remember, you can wager
up to 50 Apples. If you'd like
to cancel, please enter '0'.

[{0}]

太好了！您想押注多少个苹果？
记住，您最多可押注50个苹果。
如果想取消，请输入'0'。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Changed your mind?
I understand. Well then,
I hope we can play sometime.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
改变主意了？
我理解。那么，
希望我们以后能一起玩。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You can't bet more than
50 Apples. Remember, we
need to keep these stakes
reasonable. Please enter
a value no greater than 50.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
您不能押注超过50个苹果。
记住，我们需要保持赌注合理。
请输入不超过50的值。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So you'll be
betting ^FF0000{1}^000000 Apples.
Is that right?
Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Mm, made a mistake?
Alright, please enter the
number of Apples you
wish to place in this bet
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，弄错了？
好吧，请输入您希望
在此赌注中押注的苹果数量

scripts.text:
I'm sorry, but you
don't seem to have
enough Apples for this
bet... You can't gamble
if you can't play, you know.
scripts.translation:
抱歉，您似乎没有足够的苹果进行此赌注……
您知道，没法玩就不能赌博。

scripts.text:
[{0}]

Now we can start
this game! I'll roll first~
^3355FF*Rolling and rumbling*^000000
scripts.translation:

我明白了，你不想冒输掉这局游戏的风险。我也不想，让我们以平局结束这局游戏。下次再玩吧~

[{0}]
It couldn't hurt to try.
Well, I win this time.
I'm sorry, let's try play

[{0}]
试试也无妨。
好吧，这次我赢了。
